about: The Maytronics dolphin robotic pool cleaner is the perfect solution for cleaning your swimming pool quickly and efficiently. This robotic cleaner features a powerful motor and advanced cleaning technology to scrub, vacuum, and filter dirt and debris from your pool's surface and walls.

Avish Aquatech distributes Pentair Pool Products in the Middle East. Pentair swimming pool products and accessories are now easily available in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other UAE (United Arab Emirates) regions and Saudi Arabia. Swimming pool equipment from Pentair is now delivered to neighboring countries like Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and other GCC countries at the best price and service.
